strings.html.intro: For buyers planning a purchase. Your requirements are reviewed by the team.

strings.lead.unsent: Unpublished preview — your enquiry has not been sent. This draft does not save or transmit your details. You can contact Black Swan Real Estate using the telephone or WhatsApp links.
strings.lead.required: Please check the required enquiry details and contact consent before submitting.
strings.lead.unaccepted: We could not accept this enquiry. Please use the telephone or WhatsApp contact option.
strings.lead.secure: This browser could not prepare a secure enquiry. Please use the telephone or WhatsApp contact option.
strings.lead.changed_details: Receipt of your earlier attempt is still unconfirmed. Some details have changed, so they have not been resent. Restore the original details to retry the same request, or contact us by phone or WhatsApp to check it. This prevents a duplicate enquiry.
strings.lead.changed_analytics: Receipt of your earlier attempt is still unconfirmed, and your analytics consent has changed. To respect your current choice, this request cannot be resent with its original attribution. Please contact us by phone or WhatsApp to check the earlier enquiry.
strings.lead.changed_ads: Receipt of your earlier attempt is still unconfirmed, and your advertising permission has changed. Please contact us by phone or WhatsApp to check that enquiry before sending another request.
strings.lead.validation: The service rejected these details before accepting the enquiry. Please review your required fields and consent, then submit again. Your next corrected attempt will receive a new request reference.
strings.lead.conflict: The service could not reconcile this request reference. Your details have not been resent under a new reference. Please contact us by phone or WhatsApp to check the enquiry.
strings.lead.receipt_prefix: Your enquiry has been received. Reference:
strings.lead.receipt_suffix: . Black Swan Real Estate can now review your request. This receipt does not confirm property availability or qualification.
strings.lead.uncertain: We could not confirm receipt. Your enquiry may not have been accepted. Please retry; the same request reference will be reused to prevent a duplicate, or contact us by phone or WhatsApp.

strings.page.title: Discuss your Dubai off-plan purchase
strings.page.intro: Considering a property purchase in Dubai before completion? Tell Black Swan Real Estate your preferred property type, Dubai areas, total budget and purchase timeline.
strings.page.plans_body: Explain whether you are considering a future home or a property purchase as an investment. Include any preferred handover timing and questions you want to discuss.
strings.page.details_title: What to include in your enquiry
strings.page.detail_1: Your preferred property type and areas in Dubai.
strings.page.detail_2: Your total purchase budget, not only a deposit. Form amounts are in AED.
strings.page.detail_3: Your purchase timeline and any preferred handover timing.
strings.page.detail_4: Your country of residence and the questions you want to discuss.
strings.page.step_1: Describe your requirements and total budget.
strings.page.step_2: Discuss suitable project information with the team.
strings.page.step_3: Confirm availability, payment terms, completion information and purchase documents before deciding.
strings.page.faq_project_q: Do I need to choose a project first?
strings.page.faq_project_a: No. Begin with your requirements. Any project details and availability must be checked before a decision.
strings.page.faq_price_q: Are prices or handover dates guaranteed here?
strings.page.faq_price_a: No. This page offers no specific property, price or availability. Confirm current details directly.
strings.page.faq_qualification_q: Does an enquiry confirm that I am a qualified buyer?
strings.page.faq_qualification_a: No. The team must review your requirements and intention. An enquiry does not reserve a property or confirm eligibility to buy.
strings.page.contact_cta: Open the current English enquiry form
strings.page.form_notice: The current live enquiry form is in English. The translated form below is disabled for review.
strings.page.privacy_notice: The current privacy notice is in English. Translated privacy information is awaiting review.
